expandtemplates.wikitext: @@name@@Martial Cadence@@icon@@Martial Cadence.png@@icon2@@{{{icon2}}}@@icon3@@{{{icon3}}}@@icon4@@{{{icon4}}}@@description@@'''Innate:''' '''Jarvan IV's''' [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attacks]] are empowered to deal '''bonus''' physical damage equal to 8% of the target's '''current''' health, with a minimum threshold of 20 and capped at 400 against non-[[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champion]] targets.@@description2@@This effect cannot occur on the same target more than once every few seconds.@@description3@@{{{description3}}}@@description4@@{{{description4}}}@@description5@@{{{description5}}}@@description6@@{{{description6}}}@@leveling@@{{{leveling}}}@@leveling2@@{{{leveling2}}}@@leveling3@@{{{leveling3}}}@@leveling4@@{{{leveling4}}}@@leveling5@@{{{leveling5}}}@@leveling6@@{{{leveling6}}}@@range@@{{{range}}}@@radius@@{{{radius}}}@@effectradius@@{{{effect radius}}}@@width@@{{{width}}}@@speed@@{{{speed}}}@@casttime@@{{{cast time}}}@@cost@@{{{cost}}}@@cooldown@@{{{cooldown}}}@@targeting@@Passive@@damagetype@@Physical@@spellshield@@False@@projectile@@{{{projectile}}}@@notes@@ * ''Martial Cadence's'' damage is based on the current health of the target before any damage of the attack has been dealt. * ''Martial Cadence's'' damage is dealt after the main attack damage. ** If the target dies to the main attack damage, the additional damage will not be dealt. * The empowered attack will not trigger against [[File:Structure icon.png|20px|link=Category:Structure|An icon representing the keyword Structure]] [[:Category:Structure|structures]].@@
